family: All Boolean truth tables on uniform cubes n=1,2,3,4
symmetry: Global output negation only: fix truth-table value at vertex 0 to +1. Squared spectrum and all influences are invariant.
pilot: n<=3 only, under 60 seconds; discovery floats have no proof status
arithmetic: integer Walsh coefficients; rational certified log2 lookup via range reduction and atanh remainder; exact equality handled symbolically
target: Determine a rational K with some relevant i satisfying B_i=H(S_i|S_-i)<=K I_i. Intended application: affine Fourier support dimension<=4 and disjoint products, subject to separate proof.
